svg.title: How an information-theory paper uses LeanInfoTheory and mathlib
svg.desc: Arrows point from a result to the mathematics it uses. The paper’s main theorem uses its own definitions, intermediate lemmas and problem-specific estimates. These draw on LeanInfoTheory’s entropy and chain rules, independence and mutual information, and channels and support facts. The common foundation is mathlib’s probability mass functions, finite sums, real analysis and finite types.
